spec: Preview ordered power effects by executing the same effect runner on an isolated battle fork. Later packets see consumed Protection and prior status/stat changes. Live state, events and RNG remain unchanged. Constitution Law 1; V2 shared preview/resolution contract.
expect: Two 5-damage packets against Protection 3 preview and apply 7; removing Protection before a 7-damage packet previews and applies 7 even against Protection 20. Boundary pools and per-packet Resist agree; repeated previews change nothing live.
note: The test variants are authored in content/test and fielded through registered scenarios. Existing control parties gain no new actions. Damage remains the resolved amount before HP clamping; healing retains the requested amount and additionally exposes healingApplied for UI display.
